title: Quite expensive
body: The app is nice but the price is so high that for me it’s a no-go. I think I’d have paid up to 3-5 € a month but 20 € is way too much…
author: Natokani

title: Great App to a Great Book
body:
Loved the book, and now I’m enjoying the App! 

Set habits with help of the App, so easy! 

Get reminders to follow your habits!
author: Andrew O’Neill

title: Great App
body:
Read Atomic Habits some time back and thought an accompanying app would be perfect. 

I use Garmin Connect to track my sport habits, but Atoms helps me focus on the goals behind these habits, and it allows me to focus on other areas of endeavour.

thanks James Clear
author: MakoneP

title: Great App! It’s simple and it works great!
body: I love it, like al the other material from James Clear this App is useful, simple and effective! Really great help for achieving my mini steps towards my goals each day
